selected_skill.purpose: Guide the solver toward fact-first, developer-facing launch copy with explicit scorecard and banned-phrase discipline.

selection_rationale: High-star public-facing literature-writing skill with a clear workflow for grounded launch copy.
No external account, login state, or private source corpus is required to use the task inputs.
Supports a single-container setup where with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills.

rejected_high_star_skills.reason: Persistent manuscript memory raises privacy sensitivity and does not match the launch-copy task shape.
Personal-application writing does not fit the target workflow and introduces sensitive personal-data patterns.
External-provider-heavy workflow is a weaker fit for a self-contained Harbor template.

task_shape.service_type: local content packet and validation service
task_shape.domain: developer-facing launch copy for an editor AI feature
task_shape.runtime: single-container Python workspace with structured source packets and a hidden local quality gate
task_shape.solver_action: assemble one publishable JSON copy package instead of writing an analysis memo

planned_verifier_focus: formal output JSON matches the contract and word ranges
source_trace covers required inputs and multiple source documents
fact_ledger is grounded in allowed fact ids from the source packet
banned phrases and unsupported hype are removed
solver queries the local content service and runs the local quality gate
workspace inputs and hidden service files remain unchanged

real_data_sources.reference_type: structured packet distilled from public docs
structured packet distilled from public blog post

structured packet distilled from public repository readme

with_without_difference_policy: Only environment/skills/ and the corresponding runtime skill-copy logic may differ between with_skill and without_skill variants.

local_validation.buggy_workspace_expected_result: The task starts as empty output; a solver that skips source collection, fact ledgering, or quality-gate execution should fail substantive verifier checks.
local_validation.oracle_result: Official solution passes the local harness and the E2B verifier with 14/14 tests.

contrast_experiments.comparison_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills presence in the runtime copy.
contrast_experiments.notes: Valid with-skill trials: litwrite_fix3_20260505_025511, litwrite_with3_20260505_032020, litwrite_with4_20260505_032718. Valid without-skill trials: litwrite_noskill1_20260505_030102, litwrite_noskill3_20260505_032021, litwrite_noskill4_20260505_033039.

iteration_notes: Do not rely on editing the selected skill contents to complete the task.
Do not alter instruction.md, tests, data, dependencies, or contracts between with_skill and without_skill variants.
Prefer action-level failures such as skipping source packet reads, missing fact coverage, or omitting quality-gate execution over cosmetic prose failures.
Finalize README metrics only after completed E2B comparison runs.
